Rounding in Household Surveys

  • Ada Moss
  • Wei Lin
Journal of Example Perspectives
vol. 40, no. 1, Winter 2026
(pp. 3–26)
Article Information

Abstract

Households that report spending often answer in round numbers. We show how much this rounding changes measured inequality and how to undo it.

Citation

Moss, Ada, and Wei Lin. 2026. "Rounding in Household Surveys." Journal of Example Perspectives 40 (1): 3–26.
